---
title: "Prototypes"
# Type view: every page whose `type` is `prototype`, newest first.
# Type, folder, title, and sort come from data/types.yml, and `contents:` must
# list every folder in it (Quarto can't read it; tests/test_site_skeleton.py
# fails on drift). No theme column: a listing can only show the raw slug, not
# the display name; the Theme views group pages by theme instead.
listing:
  id: prototypes
  contents:
    - "../topics/*.qmd"
    - "../topics/*.md"
    - "../dictionary/*.qmd"
    - "../dictionary/*.md"
    - "../essays/*.qmd"
    - "../essays/*.md"
    - "../prototypes/*.qmd"
    - "../prototypes/*.md"
    - "../tools/*.qmd"
    - "../tools/*.md"
  include:
    type: prototype
  type: table
  sort: ["date desc", "title"]
  fields: [date, title, maturity]
  field-display-names:
    maturity: "Maturity"
  sort-ui: false
---
